title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke U on 1973-12-08
lineage: CD > Soundforge 8 for all adjustments > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Fantastic soundboard recording of a top‑form performance, hailed as one of the reviewer’s favorite shows.
ai_review.review: The SBD (soundboard) source delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets listeners hear the band at the height of its powers. The performance is described as “top form,” with no missteps, making it a standout entry in the listener’s collection. Overall, both the music and the recording are praised without reservation.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights an excellent soundboard recording and a stellar performance, suggesting near‑perfect quality, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a “fantastic SBD recording,” indicating clear, balanced sound with no noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Band is in top form throughout; consistent energy and tight playing make for an engaging set.
